text.tspan: She still steals socks. We are negotiating.

easier.

life for both of us.
Routines are love in animal language.

Pet insurance paperwork is annoying and was
worth it once. Responsible ownership includes

relationship work, not dominance theater.
Patience beats volume. Know your emergency
clinic before you need it. Animals notice
